description:
Four crate-level status banners in raffles say the crate is empty. It is not.

FALSE claims:
- crates/raffles/README.md:11-15  "SCAFFOLD ONLY -- nothing is implemented. This crate currently contains module boundaries, licensing and provenance, and nothing else. No distribution, no sampler, no sensitivity estimator, no surrogate."
- crates/raffles/src/lib.rs:13-18  "## Status -- SCAFFOLD ONLY / Nothing is implemented. Every module below is an empty, documented placeholder... No distribution, sampler, estimator or surrogate exists yet"
- crates/raffles/CLAUDE.md:13  "Current state: scaffold. Module boundaries, licensing and provenance only."
- workspace CLAUDE.md:830 (Members table)  "Scaffold only, nothing implemented, no human V&V."

ACTUAL state (measured 2026-08-07):
  distributions.rs  2795 lines / 1689 non-comment / 14 #[test]
  samplers.rs       1460 lines /  585 non-comment / 13 #[test]
  sensitivity.rs    1241 lines /  542 non-comment /  7 #[test]
Zero todo!()/unimplemented!() in the crate. Real public API e.g. sensitivity.rs:301 pearson_correlation, :360 spearman_correlation, :466 SobolSampleLayout; samplers.rs:772 enum Sampler, :807 fn generate. (Tests not run in this pass -- counts are #[test] attribute counts.)

WHAT IS accurate and must NOT be "fixed": surrogate.rs is genuinely empty -- 54 lines, 0 non-comment lines, and its own header (:3) plus README.md:37 correctly say so. Only the four crate-level banners are wrong.

Docs that under-report capability cause work to be redone. Correct all four; keep the "no human V&V" caveat, which is still true.
title: raffles: four crate-level docs falsely claim scaffold-only / nothing implemented
